'''Sirta Kum''' was a [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]],<ref name="QOM" /> a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] distinguished by tresses of vibrantly-[[Color/Legends|colored]] head tendrils.<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> Kum trained as a [[Scientist/Legends|pharmacologist]], and spent two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] living with an [[Araquia]]n tribe on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirtania]].Working with [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[T'Jaleq Kith'Araquia]], Kum discovered that, when boiled, the fluid from inside [[Shiarha Root]]s could cure the [[Direllian Plague]], a deadly respiratory disease. Kum was a noted pharmacologist during the years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], sharing credit for discovering the cure for the Direllian Plague with Dr. Kith'Araquia. The scientist established a positive reputation for the Ho'Din species among Kith'Araquia's tribe, such that some years later when Araquians from that tribe encountered [[Kutu (Ho'Din)|Kutu]], another Ho'Din, they did not attack her; however, the Ho'Din's companions were not so well treated.<ref name="QOM" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Nicky Rea]] created Sirta Kum for the [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure "[[The Quality of Mercy]]," published by [[West End Games]] in [[February]] [[1994]] as part of [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 1]].<ref name="QOM" />
